name: Book Flip
description: The right half of the first clip turns over like a book page on a spine in the middle, curling near its free edge, its back bringing the left half of the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the page darkens as it turns, and the shadows it casts

params.name: curl
params.description: How much the page bends near its free edge
